summary: A bilingual sequence-and-structure T5 that fine-tunes ProtT5-XL on translating between amino acids and Foldseek 3Di structure tokens; its 1024-dim encoder embeddings carry structure-aware signal.
architecture: T5 encoder–decoder initialized from ProtT5-XL-UniRef50 and trained to translate between amino-acid sequences and 3Di structural tokens; the encoder yields 1024-dim per-residue embeddings used here.
pretraining_data: 17M non-redundant proteins with high-quality predicted structures from the AlphaFold Protein Structure Database, converted to 3Di tokens with Foldseek.
pretraining_objective: Two steps on top of ProtT5-XL-UniRef50: continued span denoising on both amino-acid and 3Di sequences, then translation between them in both directions ('folding' and 'inverse folding').
key_innovations: Injects structural information into a sequence PLM via the 3Di structural alphabet
Enables fast structure-aware remote-homology search and structure/inverse-folding generation
when_to_use: When structure-aware sequence representations may help (e.g. binding/active-site or fold-dependent properties) while keeping sequence-only inference.
caveats: The structure signal is distilled from predicted (AlphaFold) structures, not experimental ones. Embeddings here come from the amino-acid path with the <AA2fold> prefix, as the model card recommends.

citations.authors: Heinzinger, M., Weissenow, K., Gomez Sanchez, J., Henkel, A., Mirdita, M., Steinegger, M., Rost, B.
citations.title: Bilingual language model for protein sequence and structure
